Universal Music Names Oscar Celma Senior VP of Applied AI and Machine Learning
Universal Music Group appointed Oscar Celma as senior vice president for applied artificial-intelligence and machine learning, effective immediately.

The company behind Taylor Swift and Lady Gaga said Celma would help the group harness AI and machine learning across its labels, divisions and businesses. He will report to Chief Data Officer Hannah Poferl.
Celma has most recently led machine learning and product analytics at Conde Nast and previously served as director of engineering at Spotify Technology.
